notes.title: WE ARE SO SORRY!
notes.content:
[b]We sincerely apologize to all of you![/b] Unfortunately, we encountered technical issues that prevented us from delivering [u][b]Achievements[/b][/u] for your hard work in this awesome game. It's our fault that you weren't able to receive them until now, but the good news is, [b]they're here![/b] 🎉

For those of you who have already made progress in the game, [u][b]simply load your saved game[/b][/u], and all the achievements you've earned should be granted to you instantly.

We hope you enjoy this update and wish you the best of luck as you work towards completing all the [b]achievements[/b]! 🌟

If you experience any [b]technical issues[/b], please don't hesitate to reach out to us via the [b]discussion section.[/b]

Thank you all for your incredible support, and we wish you the best [b]Futanari [/b]year ever! 🥳

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
New Update is Live! 🎉

We're excited to announce a major update for our game! Here's what's new:

[b]✨ 50 Brand-New Original Images:[/b] Dive deeper into the game with fresh, unique visuals!
[b]📖 New Album Feature:[/b] Track your progress and enjoy completed images in the all-new album.
[b]🎨 Improved Graphics:[/b] We've updated the visuals to bring you a more immersive experience.
[b]⚙️ New Features Added:[/b] Discover exciting new mechanics and enhancements throughout the game.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We hope you enjoy these updates as much as we enjoyed creating them! ❤️

notes.title: Big Update is comming!
notes.content:
[b]🌸 Hello to all Futanari fans! 🌸[/b]

We’ve got [b]amazing news[/b] for you! 🎉 [b]A BIG UPDATE[/b] for the game is coming at the end of this month! 🔥

Here’s what’s in store:

✨ [b]50 brand new levels[/b] featuring stunning images of elven futanaris—each one more breathtaking than the last!
✨ [b]NEW ALBUM feature![/b] 📸 Now you’ll be able to check out your collection of completed images anytime in the menu!

But that’s not all! 😏 We’re excited to announce that a [b]brand new game[/b] is in the works, and it’s something extra special for all of you who love Futanari! Get ready for...

[b]💥 Futanari BONDAGE 💥[/b]

In this upcoming visual novel, you’ll step into the role of a professional photographer 📷, working with gorgeous models. As you complete levels, you’ll capture stunning photos of beautiful futanari girls in intricate bondage poses. 💖

Keep an eye on the Steam store—the new game will be visible in just [b]two weeks![/b] 🕒 Stay tuned, and thank you for all your support!

Your feedback and comments truly [b]help us[/b] make our games even better, so please keep sharing your thoughts! 🙏

notes.title: Multi Language Patch
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are excited to announce that a new patch has been released for our game, now with support for multiple languages! Based on your requests and feedback, you can now experience the game in the following languages:

English
한국어 (Korean)
Deutsch (German)
Česky (Czech)
Français (French)
Italiano (Italian)
Polski (Polish)
Español (Spanish)
Português (Portuguese)
Magyar (Hungarian)
日本語 (Japanese)
Русский (Russian)
中文 (Chinese)

This patch allows you to play the game in your native language for an even more immersive experience! If you already have the game installed, the update should download automatically. If you encounter any issues, please let us know.

Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts and reviews in these new languages!

notes.title: BIG Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Big Update Incoming – Taking Futanari's Secret to the Next Level![/b][/h1]

Hey everyone! We're thrilled to announce a major update coming soon to Futanari's Secret that will elevate your experience to a whole new level.

While the game already features an impressive collection of [b]106 high-quality images[/b], we know you want more—and we're delivering!
In this update, we're adding [b]50 brand new images[/b], making the experience even richer!

But that's not all! We're also introducing a [b]cheat feature[/b] for players who want to speed things up—unlock any image with a single click!
And to make the visuals pop even more, we've got some [b]new, exciting visual effects[/b] lined up that will truly enhance the gameplay experience.

[b][h1]What’s coming in this update?[/h1][/b]

[h3][b]50 new high-quality images[/b]
[b]Cheat feature:[/b] Solve puzzles instantly!
[b]Improved visual effects[/b] for a better experience[/h3]

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your continued support!
